en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays in force; Thunderstorm Warning until 10pm
en.dek: Tropical Depression Saudel was about 240 km southeast of Hong Kong at 8pm; the Observatory said the chance of a Strong Wind Signal remains relatively low.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 remained in force on Tuesday evening as Tropical Depression Saudel continued to track across the northern South China Sea.

At 8pm, Saudel was estimated about 240 kilometres southeast of Hong Kong near 20.5 degrees north, 115.5 degrees east, and was forecast to move northeast at about 14 kilometres per hour. The Observatory said the signal would stay in force for the rest of the day and Wednesday morning.

A Thunderstorm Warning was issued at 7.50pm and was valid until 10pm, with isolated squally thunderstorms expected over Hong Kong. The Observatory said Saudel was skirting more than 200 kilometres to the southeast, with its outer rainbands bringing squally showers to the Guangdong coast.

Unless Saudel intensifies significantly and its strong winds move closer to the Pearl River Estuary, the chance of strong winds generally over Hong Kong is not high, the Observatory said. Local winds were expected to be occasionally strong offshore and on high ground under the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號繼續生效 雷暴警告至晚上10時
zh.dek: 熱帶低氣壓沙德爾晚上8時位於本港東南約240公里；天文台指發出三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。
body: 天文台表示，一號戒備信號周二晚繼續生效，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾仍在南海北部移動。
晚上8時，沙德爾集結在本港東南約240公里，即北緯20.5度、東經115.5度附近，預料向東北移動，時速約14公里。天文台指信號會維持至今日餘下時間及周三早上。
天文台於晚上7時50分發出雷暴警告，有效至晚上10時，預料本港有局部地區狂風雷暴。沙德爾正於本港東南逾200公里外掠過，其外圍雨帶為廣東沿岸帶來狂風驟雨。
天文台表示，除非沙德爾顯著增強且相關強風區更接近珠江口一帶，否則本港普遍吹強風機會不大。在沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響下，離岸及高地間中吹強風。
